SystemSettings.label_overhead_calc_info:
Fixed business costs distributed proportionally per print hour.
Absorbed into the Operating Cost (not visible to the client).
SystemSettings.tooltip_electricity_rate:
Base electricity rate in your country or region.
Multiplied by the Correction Factor to obtain the real cost.
SystemSettings.tooltip_elect_correction:
Correction over the nominal rate to cover real charges:
consumption tiers, peak demand or taxes not included.
Value 1.0 = uses exactly the entered rate.
SystemSettings.tooltip_default_failure_m:
Additional percentage over the base cost to cover print failures,
wasted material or reprints. Applied to total cost before margin.
Example: 5% on a cost of 100 → base price of 105.
SystemSettings.tooltip_default_profit_ma:
Profit or commission percentage you want to earn on the final price.
This is the commercial margin of the service: covers your business profits.
Example: 30% commission → price = cost / (1 - 0.30).
Enable 'Shield Commission' to protect this percentage from VAT.
SystemSettings.tooltip_tax_rate: VAT or local tax percentage applicable to the final price.
SystemSettings.tooltip_overhead_rent: Monthly cost of the premises or physical space where you operate.
SystemSettings.tooltip_overhead_accounti: Monthly fees for accountant or bookkeeping services.
SystemSettings.tooltip_overhead_salary: Your own salary or employees not directly charged to each print job.
SystemSettings.tooltip_overhead_other: Any other monthly fixed cost not covered by the fields above.
_section_system_settings_tooltips: --- SystemSettingsWidget tooltips, placeholders, checkboxes and messages ---
SystemSettings.tooltip_hours_day: Average hours per day your printers are active.
SystemSettings.tooltip_days_month: Working days per month used to distribute fixed expenses.
SystemSettings.tooltip_active_printers_l: Number of printers working simultaneously. Used to distribute overhead among them.
SystemSettings.tooltip_printers_mode_com:
Auto: uses the number of active printers registered in the database.
Manual: allows indicating a fixed number regardless of registration.
SystemSettings.tooltip_active_printers_s: Number of active printers to use for overhead distribution.
SystemSettings.tooltip_monthly_hours: Calculated total: hours/day × days/month × active printers.
SystemSettings.tooltip_format_group: Define how the document will look: font, titles, and visual appearance
SystemSettings.tooltip_pdf_font: System font to use in the PDF document (full Unicode support)
SystemSettings.tooltip_primary_color:
Main document color HEX code (#RRGGBB).
If left empty, uses the default color.
SystemSettings.tooltip_content_group: Define what information is included in the document, regardless of style
SystemSettings.tooltip_display_mode:
Detailed: shows each cost separately.
Summary: groups Material + Energy + Operation + Margin into a single concept.
SystemSettings.tooltip_service_label:
Name of the single concept that appears in Summary mode.
Ex: 3D Printing Service, Manufacturing, Production, etc.
SystemSettings.tooltip_comments_group:
Free text that appears at the end of the document as conditions, terms, or clarifications.
Write each rule or comment on a separate line.
These will appear at the end of the PDF as terms and conditions.
SystemSettings.tooltip_note_format_group: Define the visual aspect of the Price Note generated as an image
SystemSettings.tooltip_note_title: Text that appears as the main header of the note
SystemSettings.tooltip_note_font: System font to use in the Price Note (full Unicode support)
SystemSettings.tooltip_note_color:
Main note color HEX code (#RRGGBB).
If left empty, uses the primary color configured in the PDF.
SystemSettings.tooltip_note_present_grou: Define how information is displayed in the Price Note.
SystemSettings.tooltip_post_processing_m:
Checked: post-processing is added to the Commission amount without its own line.
Unchecked: appears as a separate row in the document.
SystemSettings.tooltip_failure_margin_mo:
Checked: error margin is added to the Operating Cost without its own line.
Unchecked: appears as a separate row in the document.
SystemSettings.tooltip_validity_enabled: Checked: adds the configured validity period to the bottom of the note.
SystemSettings.tooltip_validity_days: Number of days for which the note is valid (1-30).
SystemSettings.tooltip_note_obs_group:
Legal disclaimer text that appears at the bottom of the note.
For example: that the note has no tax validity, expiration date, etc.
SystemSettings.tooltip_exchange_rates: Click to configure exchange rates between currencies
SystemSettings.tooltip_open_log: Opens the log file for the current month to share with support
